#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
#include <array>
#include <numeric>
#include <functional>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
ll n, ans;
const int K = 16;
array<ll, K> A;
array<ll, K> B;
vector<ll> b; // B
vector<ll> v;
ll m;

void dfs(int pos, ll now, ll res) {
	if (res >= ans) return;
	if (pos == 0) {
		if (!now) ans = res;
		return;
	}
	int t = now / A[pos];
	int d = abs(t) - 1;
	if (t < 0) d = -d;
	int s = abs(t) + 1;
	if (t < 0) s = -s;
	dfs(pos - 1, now - t * B[pos], res + abs(t) * pos);
	dfs(pos - 1, now - d * B[pos], res + abs(d) * pos);
	dfs(pos - 1, now - s * B[pos], res + abs(s) * pos);
}

int main() {
	B[1] = 1;
	for (int i = 2; i <= K; i++) {
		B[i] = B[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
	}
	A[1] = 1;
	for (int i = 2; i <= K; i++) {
		A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10;
	}
	scanf("%lld", &n);
	m = n;
	int c = 0;
	while (m) {
		c++;
		m /= 10;
	}
	ans = numeric_limits<ll>::max();
	dfs(c, n, 0);
	dfs(c, B[c + 1] - n, c + 1);
	cout << ans << endl;
	return 0;
}
